column1: # machorun DRAWING-fixture manifest -- tab separated, one PNG-producing fixture
# per line. The sibling of tests/manifest.tsv, and separate from it on purpose.
# WHY A SECOND MANIFEST. tests/manifest.tsv indexes fixtures whose whole result
# is stdout/stderr/exit-status, which is what harness/run_macos.sh and
# harness/run_linux.sh know how to capture and what scripts/difftest.sh knows
# how to grade. The fixtures below differ from those in two structural ways:
#   * their headline artefact is a FILE -- a PNG written to argv[1]; and
#   * their macOS run needs DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, because their install name for
#     the drawing engine is the absolute Darwin path /usr/lib/libquartz.dylib,
#     which is a file on neither host (scripts/build_quartz_macos.sh explains
#     why that is the right install name and why @rpath would be wrong -- in
#     short, @rpath resolves the same on both hosts, so both runs would load
#     the same library and the Linux run would silently test nothing).
# Teaching the shared harness either of those would put a fixture-specific
# special case into the thing that grades every other fixture. So these have
# their own runner, scripts/quartz_pixel.sh, which obeys exactly the same rules:
# it re-executes the macOS oracle every run rather than trusting the committed
# baseline, it writes tests/expected/ only under --record and only on Darwin,
# and a baseline that has moved is reported as BASELINE-DRIFT rather than
# quietly re-recorded.
# id      fixture id; tests/bin/<id> is the Mach-O, tests/expected/<id>.{png,
#         stdout,stderr,exit} is the recorded macOS behaviour
# rung    position on the ladder in docs/FIXTURES.md
# needs   dylibs the guest loads beyond libSystem, comma separated. The Linux
#         side builds exactly these: `objc` costs a minute of Objective-C++, so
#         a quartz-only run must not pay for it.
# size    the bitmap the fixture creates, for the reader
# what    one-line description
# Columns are separated by a single TAB. Keep it that way.
#id
15_quartz
